moto-gloves-eclipse.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Eclipse
moto-gloves-eclipse.desc:
These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. This is the original classic black design that made Tortue a household name.

Don't call it a midlife crisis

driver-gloves-black-tie.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Black Tie
driver-gloves-black-tie.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

specialist-gloves-lime-polycam.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Lime Polycam
specialist-gloves-lime-polycam.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

specialist-gloves-foundation.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Foundation
specialist-gloves-foundation.desc:
Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. The white and black gloves have been given orange accents

Rumor has it that Tortue was inspired by the Asiimov line of firearms

bloodhound-gloves-bronzed.name: ★ Bloodhound Gloves | Bronzed
bloodhound-gloves-bronzed.desc:
These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Bloodhound logo. The leather has been dyed gun metal and bronze.

Operation Bloodhound marked the end of rouge sniper Chase Turner

ak-47-head-shot.name: AK-47 | Head Shot
ak-47-head-shot.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a "HEAD SHOT GUN" graffiti and finished with pearlescent coating.

Everyone has goals, but are you willing to put in the work to achieve them? - Booth, Arms Dealer

ak-47-slate.name: AK-47 | Slate
ak-47-slate.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom paint job has been applied which can only be described as "black on black on slate black".

"Call a doctor, they're gonna need one"

aug-radiation-hazard.name: AUG | Radiation Hazard
aug-radiation-hazard.desc: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

awp-silk-tiger.name: AWP | Silk Tiger
awp-silk-tiger.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A hydrographic tiger pattern has been applied over a blue base.

A national treasure—the tiger, not the AWP

awp-phobos.name: AWP | Phobos
awp-phobos.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It is constructed of metal panels and durable electronic components.

Build a better world

awp-boom.name: AWP | BOOM
awp-boom.desc: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted using a hydrographic printed with comic book onomatopoeia over an orange base coat.

awp-sun-in-leo.name: AWP | Sun in Leo
awp-sun-in-leo.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

It's going to be a rough month for your enemies

bayonet-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-phase-4.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bayonet-freehand.name: ★ Bayonet | Freehand
bayonet-freehand.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

pp-bizon-carbon-fiber.name: PP-Bizon | Carbon Fiber
pp-bizon-carbon-fiber.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic over a graphite base coat.

Just because I carried my team doesn't mean it wasn't a team effort - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

pp-bizon-facility-sketch.name: PP-Bizon | Facility Sketch
pp-bizon-facility-sketch.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A grayscale hydrographic pattern resembling a nuclear power plant has been applied.

"Your point of entry is the ventilation system"

cz75-auto-hydraulics.name: CZ75-Auto | Hydraulics
cz75-auto-hydraulics.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. The magazine has been painted to resemble a polymer material. "HYDRA" has been painted above the trigger.

Are you Heracles?

desert-eagle-golden-koi.name: Desert Eagle | Golden Koi
desert-eagle-golden-koi.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. This memento from Chinatown has been covered in a metallic foil with a scale pattern.

A loud gun in every sense of the word

desert-eagle-corinthian.name: Desert Eagle | Corinthian
desert-eagle-corinthian.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been laser-etched and given a custom leather grip.

Protect. Hope. Trust. Persevere.

desert-eagle-hand-cannon.name: Desert Eagle | Hand Cannon
desert-eagle-hand-cannon.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has brass parts that have been given an acid patina inspired by antique brass cannons.

Be prepared to encounter many thorns in the trials to come

desert-eagle-urban-rubble.name: Desert Eagle | Urban Rubble
desert-eagle-urban-rubble.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

famas-sergeant.name: FAMAS | Sergeant
famas-sergeant.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been given a patina of varying depth using masking fluid to create a military motif, sealed with a satin finish.

Lead by example

g3sg1-green-cell.name: G3SG1 | Green Cell
g3sg1-green-cell.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been spray-painted with a green and black hex pattern.

Hex marks the spot

glock-18-gold-toof.name: Glock-18 | Gold Toof
glock-18-gold-toof.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a pink grip and an aggressive forward-facing gaze.

"This one's for you!"

p2000-scorpion.name: P2000 | Scorpion
p2000-scorpion.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted using anodized-effect paints in a rippled fade pattern with a red scorpion decal on the grip.

butterfly-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel
butterfly-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

paracord-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

paracord-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Boreal Forest
paracord-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

classic-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Classic Knife | Boreal Forest
classic-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Gamma Doppler
falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

flip-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Flip Knife | Rust Coat
flip-knife-rust-coat.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

navaja-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m9-bayonet-lore.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Lore
m9-bayonet-lore.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

m9-bayonet-crimson-web.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web
m9-bayonet-crimson-web.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

nomad-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-4.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

shadow-daggers-freehand.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Freehand
shadow-daggers-freehand.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

skeleton-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Crimson Web
skeleton-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

bowie-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-black-laminate.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Black Laminate
bowie-knife-black-laminate.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

bowie-knife-scorched.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Scorched
bowie-knife-scorched.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

huntsman-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m249-aztec.name: M249 | Aztec
m249-aztec.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. Excavated from Aztec ruins, parts of this M249 have rusted and been covered in moss.

Never trust a rope bridge

m249-spectrogram.name: M249 | Spectrogram
m249-spectrogram.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted using a green and blue halftone pattern.

This one's off the charts

m4a4-bullet-rain.name: M4A4 | Bullet Rain
m4a4-bullet-rain.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom-painted with a graphic of clouds raining bullets.

m4a1-s-moss-quartz.name: M4A1-S | Moss Quartz
m4a1-s-moss-quartz.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted with dark green metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

m4a1-s-blood-tiger.name: M4A1-S | Blood Tiger
m4a1-s-blood-tiger.desc: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic.

mac-10-nuclear-garden.name: MAC-10 | Nuclear Garden
mac-10-nuclear-garden.desc: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been chromed then overlayed with a semi transparent hydrographic pattern of nuclear skulls and bones.

mac-10-storm-camo.name: MAC-10 | Storm Camo
mac-10-storm-camo.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted using a solid blue camo pattern.

We all have to do things we don't like

mp7-forest-ddpat.name: MP7 | Forest DDPAT
mp7-forest-ddpat.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

mp9-latte-rush.name: MP9 | Latte Rush
mp9-latte-rush.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted to resemble the "Latte" drum found on Train's B site.

Start your morning right

mp9-airlock.name: MP9 | Airlock
mp9-airlock.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted white and given a stark red magazine.

Perfect for shooting toasters

negev-lionfish.name: Negev | Lionfish
negev-lionfish.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been spray painted with a randomized lionfish pattern.

Just keep swimming

nova-rain-station.name: Nova | Rain Station
nova-rain-station.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted with a pattern using different shades of blue.

The steady drizzle adds to the ambiance

p250-undertow.name: P250 | Undertow
p250-undertow.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using metallic paints with a silver slide and a blue and black spotted pattern on the receiver.

p250-contaminant.name: P250 | Contaminant
p250-contaminant.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. Its maroon topcoat has been eaten away, leaving a decaying weapon with limited remaining uses.

It's only as bad as it looks

p250-apeps-curse.name: P250 | Apep's Curse
p250-apeps-curse.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted using Egyptian patterns and materials as inspiration.

In opposition of Ra

p250-facets.name: P250 | Facets
p250-facets.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. This memento from Agency has been painted with a polygonal patterned hydrographic.

My men are professionals, they'll get the job done right... - Elliott Kingsman, Career Criminal

p250-small-game.name: P250 | Small Game
p250-small-game.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A camouflage hunter pattern has been applied to the bottom half of this P250.

The hunted becomes the hunter

p90-module.name: P90 | Module
p90-module.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted using metallic paints with an overlayed hexagonal pattern.

p90-fallout-warning.name: P90 | Fallout Warning
p90-fallout-warning.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

scar-20-wild-berry.name: SCAR-20 | Wild Berry
scar-20-wild-berry.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been custom painted using a multicolored halftone design.

"I can't aim"

scar-20-cardiac.name: SCAR-20 | Cardiac
scar-20-cardiac.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been heat wrapped with vinyl pre-printed in a modern orange and blue design.

beep. beep. beeeeeeeeeeeep...

scar-20-arctic-camo-panels.name: SCAR-20 | Arctic Camo Panels
scar-20-arctic-camo-panels.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A green and grey camo pattern has been applied.

Calling all Arctic Avengers!

sg-553-pulse.name: SG 553 | Pulse
sg-553-pulse.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been painted with a hydrographic of bold fuchsia fragments.

Striking colors for a striking weapon

sg-553-bulldozer.name: SG 553 | Bulldozer
sg-553-bulldozer.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a production line yellow color scheme.

This bone crusher is a devastator

sg-553-aloha.name: SG 553 | Aloha
sg-553-aloha.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray painted with a blue hibiscus pattern.

The perfect partner

ssg-08-red-stone.name: SSG 08 | Red Stone
ssg-08-red-stone.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted with an olive grip and maroon slide.

Shame, the inscriptions have worn away with use...

tec-9-red-quartz.name: Tec-9 | Red Quartz
tec-9-red-quartz.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

tec-9-tornado.name: Tec-9 | Tornado
tec-9-tornado.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. This memento from Ali has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Words are wind, but wind can kill

ump-45-roadblock.name: UMP-45 | Roadblock
ump-45-roadblock.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with horizontal orange lines and forward facing arrows.

Seek alternate routes

usp-s-cyrex.name: USP-S | Cyrex
usp-s-cyrex.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been given discreet red highlights to give off a futuristic feel.

Imogen was the past Felix, I'm the future - Huxley, The Competition

xm1014-elegant-vines.name: XM1014 | Elegant Vines
xm1014-elegant-vines.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A red and green flower pattern has been applied.

Some see a nuisance; I see beauty

xm1014-teclu-burner.name: XM1014 | Teclu Burner
xm1014-teclu-burner.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. Metallic paint has been used to add flames.

Sometimes a bunsen isn't enough...
